questions.question: Simplify: 2³ × 2⁻¹ ÷ 2²
questions.explanation: Use the laws of indices: aᵐ × aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ and aᵐ ÷ aⁿ = aᵐ⁻ⁿ

questions.question: Solve for x: 3x - 7 = 2x + 5
questions.explanation: Collect like terms by moving variables to one side and constants to the other.

questions.question: Factorize: x² - 16
workingSteps: This is a difference of two squares: a² - b² = (a-b)(a+b)
questions.explanation: This is a difference of two squares pattern.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 7cm (π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Use the formula A = πr² for the area of a circle.
